ops.title: stack runs refuse to publish onto a pin whose parent moved (PR #284)
ops.body: ccx v0.72.30: stack submit pinned another lane's (other-worktree) branch at its published head while the run moved its own parent (an amend below it), then pushed every branch above the pin onto that stale head. Fix: stackRefuseStalePins in stackBegin refuses before anything moves when a pinned branch's parent is published at a head the pin does not contain; names --include <pin> and --to <parent>. Pins on trunk/kept/held/landed/staying parents and --no-push runs are unaffected. Test: TestStackSubmitRefusesToStackOnAPinnedBranchItsParentLeft. Merged #282/#283/#284 squash; Autobump tags each merge (v0.72.32/.33/.34).
